mcat_description.short: Folding Garage is a portable, collapsible prefabricated car shelter or carport — sold as a complete kit comprising a steel or aluminium frame and a PVC/polyester fabric or polycarbonate cover — designed to protect vehicles from sun, rain, and weather without permanent construction.
mcat_description.long: A Folding Garage is a non-permanent, foldable or retractable vehicle shelter structure sold as a ready-to-assemble kit, typically consisting of a powder-coated or galvanised steel frame with a UV-resistant, waterproof PVC-coated polyester or polyethylene fabric cover. These structures are available in manual push-pull, telescopic, and motorised/remote-controlled variants, and are sized for single or double cars, motorcycles, or light commercial vehicles. In the Indian market, they serve residential buyers lacking covered parking, small businesses needing temporary equipment shelter, and institutional buyers requiring relocatable vehicle protection. They require no foundation, no construction permit, and can be assembled and disassembled without professional labour.

market_context: In the Indian market, 'Folding Garage' and 'Foldable Carport' are used interchangeably by buyers and sellers; 'car parking shed' and 'portable car shed' are also common buyer-side terms. The dominant commercial form is a steel-framed, PVC/polyester-covered portable carport sold as a complete kit. Two structural families exist: (1) fabric-covered portable garages with powder-coated or galvanised steel frames and UV-resistant polyethylene or PVC-coated polyester covers — the budget-dominant segment; and (2) aluminium-framed structures with polycarbonate or metal roofing panels — the premium/semi-permanent segment. Manual push-pull and telescopic variants are the most common; motorised/remote-controlled automatic variants represent a growing premium sub-segment. Demand is driven by rising vehicle ownership, urban space constraints, and the absence of covered parking in residential complexes — particularly in Tier-1 and Tier-2 Indian cities (single source — low confidence on city-tier split). Key buyer-evaluated specs are frame material (galvanised vs painted steel vs aluminium), cover fabric grade (600D Oxford vs PVC-coated polyester), waterproofing rating, UV protection, wind resistance, and overall dimensions. No BIS/IS mandatory standard governs this product category in India; quality is assessed by buyers through material grade and manufacturer warranty.
